title: decision: follow mls-extensions editor's copy #110 for component negotiation
description: Published draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §4.6 says a client 'MUST understand and advertise the app_components component'; editor's copy after PR #110 (merge 500622f7, 2026-11-01) says 0x0001/0x0002 are implied, not listed, and ignored on receipt, and adds negotiation rules 2-7. Mark 2026-11-02: implement #110 now (deviation from published -10, as hcfn followed #109). Supersedes decisions mimid-1wgh.4.25 and mimid-1wgh.4.63 (K1).
